guardrails.security_patterns_vulnerabilities: No direct critical CVEs reported for react ^18.2.0 in the provided search results. Standard mitigation includes avoiding outdated third-party renderers and maintaining strict dependency updates.
guardrails.performance_constraints: Automatic batching in React 18 reduces unnecessary re-renders. Resource discovery and preloading APIs introduced in newer versions help move hints earlier to optimize browser loading times.
guardrails.linter_overrides: Use strict TypeScript typings compatible with React 18 createRoot API. Ensure ESLint rules enforce modern hooks usage and prevent legacy patterns like string refs or deprecated lifecycle methods.
